meta.subtitle: Full Composed Dashboard — Complete 1440x900 Final Render Prompt

FINAL_COMPOSED_IMAGE_PROMPT: Generate an ultra-high-resolution 16K professional SaaS dashboard UI screenshot of Flowora, an AI Communication OS for WhatsApp, Email, and Voice automation. Desktop viewport 1440x900px. Browser chrome visible at top with URL bar showing app.flowora.io. Color ratio: 92% white and off-white surfaces, 5% Cod Gray #1B1B1B sidebar, 3% Kournikova yellow #FFE27C accents. All text must be pixel-perfect, crisp, fully readable, no blur, correct English spelling throughout. Inter font family throughout. LEFT SIDEBAR (240px wide, full height, background #1B1B1B): At top — Flowora logo with three yellow hexagons + white wordmark. Below — workspace selector showing 'Acme Corp' with Pro Plan badge in yellow. Below — search bar with ⌘K hint. Navigation sections separated by small uppercase gray section labels: COMMUNICATE section containing Shared Inbox (with sky blue badge showing 34), Broadcast Campaigns, Contacts. AUTOMATE section containing Workflow Builder (NEW yellow badge), AI Chatbot, AI Voice Agent. MANAGE section containing Leads CRM, Analytics, Knowledge Hub. SETTINGS section containing Team and Agents, Integrations, Billing and Credits, Settings. HOME item at top is ACTIVE state with yellow #FFE27C background, dark text, showing LayoutDashboard icon. All other nav items show white text at 70% opacity. Bottom of sidebar shows user avatar with Robert Fox name, Admin role, AI credits progress bar in yellow showing 7850 of 10000. TOPBAR (full width minus sidebar, 56px height, white background, bottom border #E8E8E4): Left shows breadcrumb Home / Overview. Center shows search input 360px wide with gray background placeholder text. Right shows notification bell with red badge showing 5, help icon, settings icon, then user avatar with Robert Fox name and Admin badge. MAIN CONTENT AREA (background #FAFAF8, padding 24px): TOP — greeting text in 28px bold: Good Morning, Robert 👋, subtitle in gray: Your AI handled 342 conversations overnight, date in light gray. Right side shows two buttons: Create Workflow in white with border, Quick Actions in yellow #FFE27C with shadow. KPI ROW — 4 equal white cards with border and shadow: Card 1 Conversations 1,280 with green +12.5% change and MessageCircle icon on green bg. Card 2 Open Chats 132 green +8.2% Inbox icon blue bg. Card 3 Today's Leads 86 green +15.7% UserPlus icon amber bg. Card 4 Revenue $24,680 green +10.8% DollarSign green bg. Each card has a tiny sparkline chart in bottom right. AI USAGE STRIP — 3-column white card row: Column 1 AI Usage 92% with yellow progress bar and credit warning. Column 2 Voice Calls 156 with lavender phone icon. Column 3 AI Chatbot 1,024 Resolved with green badge. TWO-COLUMN SECTION below: Left 55% white card Recent Activities with 5 activity items each with colored icon circle, description text, timestamp metadata. Right 45% white card Live Inbox Overview with area chart and 4 stat columns Active 48, Waiting 17, Resolved 267, Bot Handling 53. CAMPAIGN PERFORMANCE full-width white card at bottom: Header with title, filter tabs All WhatsApp Email Voice with yellow active tab, table showing Webinar Campaign and Product Demo Campaign with columns for type badge sent delivered open click status. Overall aesthetic: clean, minimal, enterprise-grade, Deel-inspired, premium SaaS product, no decorative elements, no illustrations, professional typography throughout, consistent 12px border radius on all cards.
